comment: The panel and the maker's own tooltip both call the second output OUT A-1; the README calls it OUT B. The lines follow the panel. The eight signal inputs and the two outputs carry whatever you patch into them, so they are given no family. CTRL IN is a control voltage when the CTRL switch is up and a clock when it is down, and the cv family is the closer of the two. RANGE is configured 0 to 8 and clamped to 7.999 before use (V100-Scanner.cpp:160); onReset leaves it at 1.0, which puts two inputs in the scan.
